四级汇总词汇 · 02英文原文

The Name on Every Lunch Box

每盒午餐上的名字 · 645 词 · 7 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A bakery offered to supply a school picnic after the usual grocery delivery failed. Its cook, Bea, had enough bread and meat for lunch, but she knew one pupil had a peanut allergy and several needed a vegetarian meal. The organizer had ordered a single sandwich for everyone. Bea asked for a list of names before she began. Even a delightful filling needed a clear label. She taped the list above the cutting board.

2First she checked the refrigerator. A butcher had sent sliced beef and pork, with a tray of sausage and a small roast. Lettuce, cabbage, spinach, cucumber, and carrot came from a vendor across the road. Bea gave each ingredient a separate tray. A creamy dressing contained mayonnaise. She chose vinegar, garlic, and a pinch of pepper for a second dressing, and set out clean spoons. Her assistant wanted to combine the two dressings to save a bowl. Bea asked him to keep them separate and write their names down.

3For the first set of boxes, he spread butter on a loaf and added the meat and lettuce. For the second, he warmed a wrap in a frying pan and filled it with roast pumpkin, cabbage, and spicy cheese. Ketchup and an almond packet stayed on the other board. Bea cut a juicy onion on a spare board so it would not make the bread wet. She showed him how to fold the two halves over the filling. A separate order needed no dairy. A bean paste and a crunchy cucumber slice gave that wrap enough flavor without the creamy dressing.

4The dessert posed a second test. The bakery had labelled a waffle and a croissant, but no label identified the nut topping on the pie. Bea set that pastry aside. Her assistant made an oatmeal dough with cinnamon, raisins, blueberry jelly, and baking powder. He used a medium spoon to divide the dough evenly and slid the tray into the oven to bake. The edges turned crispy and the fluffy centers stayed chewy. He wanted to drizzle caramel on top. Bea asked him to leave the muffins plain and use a spatula to lift them without breaking them.

5At noon a parent brought yoghurt, ripe apricots, and a pint of cream. She suggested a smoothie, but Bea could not keep it cold on the field. They packed fruit and juice. Bea stirred the dip and checked the fridge. For adults, the refreshment tray could hold sparkling lemonade, crackers, popcorn, and a sour dip. The cook chose ginger as a seasoning and mixed a raspberry cube into the drink. She saved the sweeter syrup for supper. A parent offered chips and crisps from an opened bag. Bea kept them apart so a pupil would not mistake a snack for the meal with a checked label.

6A label fell off during packing. Bea checked the recipe and taped a replacement to the lid. One box held a biscuit, another a cookie. A doughnut and a bagel waited for the adults. Bea did not let a pupil mistake a humble appetizer for a checked lunch. Bea moved a cup of espresso away from the labels. The children could avoid caffeine. She packed the leftovers for dinner, then marked a spare wrap that could be eaten cold.

7On the field a boy nearly picked up a friend's box. His friend pointed at the names, then asked why his wrap had a bean stuffing instead of cheese. The boy read his label and explained it himself. He chose a seat and took a bite of the delicious lunch. The organizer had suggested an assortment of burgers and fries for next time. Now he asked for the bakery's recipe. It began with the names, which told the cook whether the next lunch should be a taco, a meatball sandwich, or a vegetable burrito or a noodle dish.

四级汇总词汇 · 02中文译文

每盒午餐上的名字

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1学校要办野餐，平时送食品的商家来不了了，一家面包房愿意接下这份订单。厨师贝娅手头的面包和肉够做午餐，可她知道有个学生对花生过敏，还有几个要吃素。组织者原先给大家订的是同一种三明治。贝娅动手前先要了一份名单。馅料再美味，也需要清楚的标签。她把名单贴到切菜板上方。

2她先检查冰箱。肉铺送来了牛肉片、猪肉片、一盘香肠和一小块烤肉。生菜、卷心菜、菠菜、黄瓜和胡萝卜来自马路对面的摊贩。她把食材各自放在不同的托盘上。一种奶油口感的酱含蛋黄酱。她用醋、蒜和少许胡椒做第二种酱，另外备好干净的勺子。助手想把两种酱混在一起，省一个碗。贝娅请他分开放，并写清各自的名字。

3第一批餐盒，他给切开的面包抹上黄油，加肉和生菜。第二批，他用煎锅热好卷饼皮，包进烤南瓜、卷心菜和带辣味的奶酪。番茄酱和一包杏仁留在另一块板上。贝娅用备用板切多汁的洋葱，免得弄湿面包。她示范怎样把饼皮两边折过馅料。还有一份不能用乳制品，豆泥和脆黄瓜片就能为那份卷饼添味。

4甜点是另一个考验。华夫饼和牛角包有标签，派上撒的坚果却没写是什么。贝娅把派放到一边。助手用燕麦、肉桂、葡萄干、蓝莓果冻和泡打粉做面团，用中号勺均分到托盘里，送进烤箱。烤完边缘酥脆，中间松软而有嚼劲。助手想淋焦糖，贝娅请他保留原味，再用铲子把松饼完整取出来。

5中午，一名家长带来酸奶、熟杏和一品脱奶油，提议做奶昔。贝娅没法在操场上一直冷藏，就改装水果和果汁。她搅了蘸酱，又查了一遍冰箱。大人的点心盘可以放气泡柠檬水、薄脆饼干、爆米花和带酸味的蘸酱。她用姜调味，在饮料里放一小块冻覆盆子，把更甜的糖浆留到晚饭。家长拿来已经拆包的薯片和脆零食，贝娅分开放，免得孩子把零食当成已经核对过标签的那份餐。

6打包时掉了一张标签。贝娅核对食谱，重新在盖子上贴好。一个盒子装饼干，另一个装曲奇，甜甜圈和贝果留给大人。她避免让学生把一小份开胃点心误当成核对过的午餐，还把一杯浓缩咖啡挪开，免得弄湿标签，孩子也能避开咖啡因。她把剩菜装起来留作晚饭，再标好一份可以冷吃的备用卷饼。

7到了操场，一个男孩差点拿错朋友的盒子。朋友指给他看两个名字，顺便问自己的卷饼为什么放豆馅。男孩读了标签，自己就能解释。他挑个座位，吃了一口午餐。组织者原想下次备汉堡和薯条。现在他请贝娅把面包房的食谱给他。食谱先列孩子们的名字，厨师才能决定下次该准备塔可、肉丸三明治、蔬菜卷饼，还是一道面食。
